links.outcome: Stereotyping or stigmatising content in AI-generated images of psychiatric diagnoses
links.effect: Images frequently reflected cultural stereotypes, historical visual tropes, gender biases and stigmatising portrayals of certain mental health conditions; no quantified rates reported.
links.quote: These images frequently reflected cultural stereotypes and historical visual tropes including gender biases and stigmatising portrayals of certain mental health conditions.

screen.reason: Empirical investigation of bias and stereotyping in text-to-image generative models (Midjourney, DALL-E 3) when prompted with psychiatric diagnoses.
